name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Tray of buttons that lights up the chosen ones, built on ui-sdk: switch between options with a sliding indicator, or toggle several filters at once with an optional All button that clears them.

files.content:
"use client"

import { use, useEffect } from "react"

import { BUTTON_GROUP_ALL, ButtonGroupContext } from "./button-group.constants"
import type { ButtonGroupAllProps } from "./button-group.types"
import { ButtonGroupItem } from "./button-group-item"

/** Lit while nothing is chosen; choosing it clears the group (`[]` in multiple, `null` in single). */
export function ButtonGroupAll(props: ButtonGroupAllProps) {
  const registerAll = use(ButtonGroupContext)?.registerAll
  useEffect(() => registerAll?.(), [registerAll])
  return <ButtonGroupItem value={BUTTON_GROUP_ALL} {...props} />
}

export { ButtonGroup } from "./button-group"
export { ButtonGroupAll } from "./button-group-all"
export { ButtonGroupItem } from "./button-group-item"
export type {
  ButtonGroupAllProps,
  ButtonGroupItemProps,
  ButtonGroupMultipleProps,
  ButtonGroupOrientation,
  ButtonGroupProps,
  ButtonGroupSelection,
  ButtonGroupSingleProps,
  ButtonGroupSize,
} from "./button-group.types"
